reasoning_quality_informational.v1_root_problem: Billing disputes doubled from about 600/month to 1180-1260 since August (E-02), and most disputed bills (1785 of 3025) are on ACTUAL reads, not estimates (E-03). No tariff change is recorded (E-04). The best-supported mechanism is that a change around August in billing import validation or read-typing handling mishandles valid reads, producing wrong bills. This is falsifiable by the rule change log (DA-RULES) showing no change near August, or by disputed actual-read bills matching their source reads.
